raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the larger Hall of Fame recognizing the IBF, asserting it was the World Boxing Hall of Fame without verification. This contradicted the earlier (correct) hypothesis of the International Boxing Hall of Fame and lacked source confirmation, leading to a premature and incorrect finalization. The correct larger Hall of Fame is the International Boxing Hall of Fame.
